create_HouseReader: create a HouseReader instance to parse a Matterport 3D .house annotation file
find_objects_with_mpcat40_index: find objects in a HouseReader filtered by a specific MP CAT40 category index
find_objects_close_to: find objects in a HouseReader close to given 2D points within a threshold distance
find_points_in_bbx: find points in a HouseReader that fall inside an object's oriented bounding box
compute_object_to_category_index_mapping: compute a mapping from object indices to MP CAT40 category indices in a HouseReader
